reason: Version 2 keeps every fact, commitment, and caveat, including the June 2027 date, the 9 to 12 month window, the six-month outreach, the redeployment and severance support, the pop-up and wholesale fallback, the Q1 2027 wind-down, and the Finance placeholders. Its tone stays closest to my own. Version 1 drops several mitigations. Versions 3 and 4 shift some claims, such as 'can't reverse,' 'put talent in one place,' and 'should return more' in place of 'stronger potential returns.'
